claim_boundary: This preflight isolates whether the social_record_store owner survives a real sys.executable process boundary through OwnerHydrationStore and FileSystemPersistenceBackend, and whether correct, empty, or paired-donor prior state changes the next owner-authored forecast. It uses two already-seen post-selected synthetic fixtures, no independent subjects, no 32K public context, no model generation, no prediction-error learning, no residual intervention, no expression, and no production ACTIVE.
